episodes.title: La Mision
episodes.summary: A young intelligence officer must leave his past behind to infiltrate Argentina's Jewish community, and report on the Andinia Plan. Soon, he will discover he is diving into waters that are deeper than what they seem.

episodes.title: La Memoria
episodes.summary: Time is of the essence, and even though Yosi is making great progress, he still can't get any specific information on the Andinia Plan. Claudia demands results, and Yosi comes up with a bold idea that could make him a hero.

episodes.title: El Hijo
episodes.summary: While he deals with Jonás' kidnapping, in the past Yosi consolidates his relationship with Dafne, who is the key to getting closer to the mysterious Saúl. His father-in-law offers him a job that will send him on a dangerous trip.

episodes.title: Jeans Nevados
episodes.summary: Yosi learns the rules of this new world he's trapped in the hard way. It's a mined field of evidence and characters with hidden agendas. After passing the initiation test, Yosi gets a new job outside the law. When he thinks things will get easier, that's when they get worse.

episodes.title: Una Alfombra
episodes.summary: Fighting between life and death, Yosi goes to Saúl, who agrees to help him repay him a debt he owed on the first trip they made together. In that trip, Yosi makes some surprising discoveries about his father-in-law's business, and a dramatic event drives them closer.

episodes.title: Casa de Muñecas
episodes.summary: After Jonás' rescue, Yosi puts some distance between him and his pursuers. Meanwhile, in the past, he gets too close to some Menajem family members, the demanding Saúl, and the unstable Dafne. A word mentioned without thought can put Yosi's plan of becoming a well-known member of the Jewish community in danger.

As a fugitive, Yosi goes back to his town and reconnects with his stepfather, without realizing the danger he's exposing him to. In the past, Yosi tries to stay in control and keep his emotions at bay. But nothing can prepare him to what's about to happen, something that will change everything forever.

episodes.title: El Idiota Útil
episodes.summary: Yosi realizes he must move quickly if he wants to avoid being the scapegoat. But as he remembers the events during his time as a spy, the puzzle pieces start to fit, and reveal a devastating truth.

episodes.title: El Abismo
episodes.summary: Going through a tough questioning by the agents investigating the attack on the Israeli Embassy, Yosi asks to be a part of the Mossad. But it won't be easy: he'll have to pass an admission test that'll put his personal safety and strongest loyalties at risk.

episodes.title: El Vuelto
episodes.summary: Yosi tries to lead his double agent life balanced without raising suspicion and is given a complex task: As he is trusted by Saul, he must personally save Dafne. All his cold blood won't be enough when his plan takes a different turn.

episodes.title: Kadish
episodes.summary: Thanks to Yosi, Dafne's kidnap is about to be solved, but a surprise factor turns the hide-out into a mine field, and everything might fall apart.

episodes.title: Mazel Tov
episodes.summary: In his endeavor to find the Condor missile, Yosi discovers there are far bigger interests than he thought behind that information. Determined not to be stopped, he turns bolder in his search while his personal life takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Silencio
episodes.summary: Things seem to finally be going well for Yosi. The search for the Condor missile is still underway, and his personal life is at its peak. But when he least expects it, something makes him lean into the deep abyss of terror.

episodes.title: Sion
episodes.summary: After the attack on AMIA, Yosi's secrets are brought to light, putting him between a rock and a hard place as he is forced to make the most important decision of his life. Meanwhile, in 2008, he has become a wanted person.

episodes.title: Traición
episodes.summary: Having lost his family and without Saul's support, Yosi gives up. At his lowest, Claudia comes to the rescue: if he wants to protect his son, he's going to have to make a move.

episodes.title: Justicia Perseguirás
episodes.summary: The existence of the Condor has been proven, and there are too many people after it. In the wrong hands, the consequences could be fatal. Time is running out, and Yosi has to decide on the path he will have to take to avoid a tragedy.
